description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Quick Cast] to the user/ [Physical Quick Cast] to all allies with 0-2/3+ Knight allies in the party, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dual Awoken Knight Mode I: Leo v2] to the user, grants [Knight Resonance +3% Boost] to all Knight allies
